title: Plurilock Shareholders Approve Plan of Arrangement for Acquisition by Quantum eMotion - Quantum Computing Report
author: Mohamed Abdel-Kareem
text:
Shareholders of Plurilock Security Inc. (TSXV: PLUR; OTCQB: PLCKF) have voted overwhelmingly in favor of the company’s previously announced acquisition by Quantum eMotion Corp. (NYSE American: QNC; TSXV: QNC; FSE: 34Q0). At a special meeting representing 68,226,137 shares (60.38% of Plurilock’s 112,989,001 issued and outstanding shares), 99.58% of votes cast, and 99.54% excluding interested parties under Multilateral Instrument 61-101, approved the plan of arrangement.

Under the September 28, 2026 arrangement agreement, Quantum eMotion will acquire all outstanding Plurilock shares for C$0.084 in cash and 0.0763 of a Quantum eMotion common share per Plurilock share, implying total consideration of C$0.28 per share. Following the shareholder vote and the management information circular filing, Plurilock is seeking a final order from the Supreme Court of British Columbia, with transaction closing and Plurilock’s subsequent delisting from the TSX Venture Exchange expected upon satisfaction of customary closing conditions.
